name: Wind & Voice of the World
subtitle: Alphorn, Duduk & more
shortDescription: 9 wind instruments and voices to play: Alphorn Mountain Echo, Alpine Yodel, Duduk and Fujara.
longDescription:
Wind & Voice of the World: 9 wind instruments and voices from 11 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Alphorn Mountain Echo, Alpine Yodel, Duduk, Fujara, Highland Bagpipe Chanter and Drone, Khene, Lusheng, Shakuhachi and Tuvan Throat Singing.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play wind instruments and vocal traditions, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
